bagPolicy.summary: Allegiant Stadium enforces a clear bag policy to enhance public safety and expedite entry. Bags must be clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC and not exceed 12” x 6” x 12”.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags not exceeding 12” x 6” x 12”
Small clutch bags, purses, or wallets 4.5" x 6.5" x 2" or smaller
bagPolicy.note: An exception is made for necessary medical items, subject to inspection.

parking.note: Parking at Allegiant Stadium can be reserved in advance through SpotHero. Parking is operated by MGM Resorts International and must be purchased ahead of time. The stadium is cashless, so payments must be made via debit/credit card or mobile payment.

rideshare.note: Rideshare pick-up and drop-off is located in Lot N, just north of the stadium.

concessions.note: Allegiant Stadium offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, including BBQ, Mexican, and Hawaiian cuisine, as well as a variety of drinks like specialty cocktails and draft beers. Notable highlights include Bloody Marys, Micheladas, and checkout-free stores for quick service.
stands: All on Red - Bloody Marys and Micheladas

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: All gates ADA accessible. Accessible seating throughout. ADA parking in all zones with valid placard + pass. ADA drop-off in Lot B near Gate 2. Contact: guestexperience@raiders.com or 725-780-2100.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Ticketmaster Box Office opens 4 hrs before event. Government-issued photo ID required. Will call drop-off not permitted.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Multiple gates, parking gates open 4 hrs before Raiders/UNLV games. Check event details for other events.
